children: India's National Stock Exchange (NSEI.NS) is set to price its initial public offering at 1,700 to 1,785 rupees a share, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday.
NSE may also reduce the stake being offered to about 5.5% of total equity capital from the originally planned 6%, according to Bloomberg News.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
